prompt: Create a square dog comic with four panels in a 2-by-2 grid, using warm storybook illustration. Keep the same cozy living room and the same reference dog throughout. Preserve its coat markings and green bandana. Panel 1: the dog sits politely by the closing door; caption "I'll be good." Panel 2: it looks toward the sofa; caption "They're gone." Panel 3: it proudly occupies a pile of cushions; caption "My house now." Panel 4: it sits innocently as the door opens; caption "Welcome back!" Read left to right, top to bottom. Use large readable captions in clear bands inside each panel. No extra panels, text, logos or watermarks.
